text: Final categorization: EXCLUDED (Justification: The paper is a non-review research article that does not focus on land use/land cover (LULC) prediction. It uses an existing LULC map of India to extract three cropping pixel types (Kharif-only, Rabi-only, double/triple) as a static input for estimating net irrigation requirement (NIR). There is no LULC modeling, simulation, or future projection of land cover changes. The study’s primary objective is to estimate and project NIR under climate change scenarios using satellite-derived crop coefficients and bias-corrected climate data. Although it operates at the national scale and uses multiple future climate scenarios (RCP4.5 and RCP8.5), it fails the core inclusion criterion that the primary focus must be LULC prediction. Furthermore, it meets the exclusion criterion “No LULC prediction component,” as LULC is treated as fixed ancillary data, not a predicted variable.)
